# Parker Tree Service

> Veteran-owned tree service in Plano, Dallas and nearby North Texas communities. A Parker family tree-care tradition founded by Brownie Parker in 1937. Tree trimming and pruning, tree removal, 24/7 emergency and storm-damage tree service, stump grinding, tree feeding and tree diagnosis for homeowners, HOAs and commercial properties.

- Phone: (214) 394-2414 (call or text; 24/7 for emergencies)
- Email: rydercapps@parkertreeservice.biz
- Service area: Plano, Allen, Parker, Richardson, Dallas, Murphy, McKinney, Garland, Wylie, Frisco, Addison, Carrollton, Lewisville, The Colony, Texas, and nearby communities in Collin, Dallas, and Denton counties
- Google Business Profile and reviews: https://share.google/iafBntMXpsoYlXGX4
- Insurance: $2 million coverage
- Estimates: prices are discussed individually after learning about the tree; no published price list

## Services

- [Tree Trimming](https://parkertreeservicetx.com/services/trimming/): Thoughtful pruning that reduces tip weight, supports balanced growth, and creates clearance around your home.
- [Tree Removal](https://parkertreeservicetx.com/services/removal/): Experienced crews and the right equipment for challenging removals, tight spaces, and large trees.
- [Storm Damage](https://parkertreeservicetx.com/services/storm-damage/): 24/7 emergency service for storm-damaged, split, uprooted and fallen trees, with help documenting tree damage for insurance claims.
- [Tree Feeding](https://parkertreeservicetx.com/services/feeding/): Targeted iron and zinc nutrition to help trees affected by nutrient deficiencies.
- [Tree Diagnosis](https://parkertreeservicetx.com/services/diagnosis/): Understand what is affecting your tree and when treatment or removal makes sense.
- [Stump Grinding](https://parkertreeservicetx.com/services/stump-grinding/): Remove the stump below ground level and reclaim usable space in your yard.

## About

- [Our story and reviews](https://parkertreeservicetx.com/about-us/): Founded by Brownie Parker in Bakersfield, California, in 1937; his son George brought the tradition to DFW; today Ryder and an experienced crew carry it forward
- [All services](https://parkertreeservicetx.com/services/)
